name: Glory to Rome
summary: Players rebuild Rome after the fire by hiring clients, gathering materials and completing buildings for influence and victory points.
rules_text: Each player has a Camp, hand of Order cards, and Influence limit for clients. On your turn as Leader you either Think to draw cards or Lead by playing an Order card as a Role: Patron, Laborer, Architect, Craftsman, Merchant, Legionary. Others in clockwise order may Follow by playing same Role or Think to draw. Then actions resolve clockwise: Leader gets one action of led Role plus one per matching Client she owns; followers who followed get same; even players who Thought get actions for their Clients. Patron takes a card from central Pool as a Client. Laborer takes Pool card as Material to Stockpile. Architect starts a new Structure foundation using card from hand matching a Site. Craftsman adds Material from Stockpile to a Foundation to finish it, gaining its power and VP. Merchant and Legionary convert cards to money and interact. Jacks are wild Roles. Pool is filled with played Role cards each turn. Leadership passes left. Game ends when conditions like draw pile empties or buildings deplete, most influence wins.
rating_reason: Card-driven role selection, hidden hands, strong bluffing strategy
